title: Machine coding scheme
statement: A machine coding scheme consists of an encoder from finite-state two-tape machine codes to finite Boolean strings, a decoder from every finite Boolean string to a finite-state two-tape machine code, and the property that decoding the encoding of any machine followed by any finite number of true bits recovers that machine.
hypotheses_covered: an encoder from machine codes to finite Boolean strings
a decoder from finite Boolean strings to machine codes
for every machine code and every natural number of padding bits, decoding its encoding followed by that many true bits returns the original machine
